title: Flash backup 10.2 - the cooker's main board wired for U7's cJTAG read
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~46 px/mm in this crop)
caption: Supply through break-out A on J8. The reset hold from TP33 to GND at JP5 pin 2, on before power. Probe A on TP13 (TMSC) and probe B on TP14 (TCKC), wired to the LaunchPad's XDS110 (picture 10.3); the LaunchPad's GND on break-out A's header pin 30. No clip on U15, nothing else on the board. The U7 close-up is picture 10.1.

terminals.label: Bench supply + (5.0 V, OVP 6 V, limit 100 mA): break-out A header pins 1-6
Bench supply -: break-out A header pin 30
LaunchPad GND (its TP2): a hook clip on break-out A header pin 30, beside the supply's -

callouts.label: = U7's TMSC: probe A
callouts.note: Beeps to U7 pin 24, not to GND, not to TP14 (raptox, J-230). Pins: picture 10.1.

callouts.label: = U7's TCKC: probe B
callouts.note: Beeps to U7 pin 25, not to GND (raptox, J-230).

callouts.label: CC2640R2F: nothing else on it
callouts.note: Only TP13 and TP14 are used; TP42, TP43, TP44 and its reset stay free.

callouts.label: no clip this time
callouts.note: Its backup exists (J-218); nothing reads it in this session.

callouts.label: = U1's nRESET: the hold probe
callouts.note: To GND before power and for the whole session (J-203, J-204): neither firmware starts, nothing talks to U7.

callouts.label: its right pad is 3.3 V, never the probe
callouts.note: Left pad = nRESET, right pad = 3V3 (J-204, J-205, J-208).

callouts.label: GND: the hold lead's ground
callouts.note: The round pad; GND (J-080). Also the meter's black lead for 10.4's checks.

callouts.label: break-out A: the supply and the LaunchPad's GND
callouts.note: Header pins 1-6 = VIN, 30 = GND (J-077, J-201); the LaunchPad's GND clip goes on pin 30 beside the supply's - lead; every other header pin open.
